text: Seed 62 has the smallest final accel_step margin (0.144) and the earliest half-final step (60), while seed 63 has 0.160 and reaches half-final at step 90. Across all completed E5 runs, does the half-final-margin step correlate with the run's final margin? If it does, the measure picks up plateau height as well as timing, and a threshold on headroom-normalized margin may be a better way to compare timing.
